decision_summary: The pre-execution governance authorization for the Stage8.1 → EMS empirical-link replay experiment is fully APPROVED. All 24 protocol requirements (authoritative treatment artifact, control forecast engine, expected origin count, eligibility rules, experimental unit, primary endpoint pre-registration, secondary endpoints, paired design, causality firewall, failure handling, protocol lock, and governance boundaries) are 100% frozen. Execution is authorized for a separate, dedicated execution task.

control_artifact.method: Causal diurnal clear-sky solar irradiance model

predeclared_rules: Must contain complete 24-step y_pred prediction values (SW_IN >= 0)
Must contain complete 24-step y_true ground truth values (SW_IN >= 0)
Must contain valid ISO-8601 UTC timestamps for origin t0 and valid horizons t0+h
Must possess valid causal runtime context and scenario inputs

endpoints.primary_endpoint_rationale: Direct physical relevance to polar microgrid fuel logistics, non-negative, high sensitivity to solar forecasting accuracy, and exposed natively by EvaluationEngine.

invariants: Same initial station state (SOC0 = 50.0%, E0 = 100 kWh)
Same actual solar ground truth trajectory (y_true from Nuolja 2024 data)
Same station demand trajectory (35 kW synthetic load)
Same SciPy MILP / HiGHS optimizer configuration
Same 24-step receding horizon MPC execution protocol

statistical_dependence_handling.method: Paired origin-level non-parametric bootstrap resampling (10,000 iterations over N=173 origins) and Wilcoxon signed-rank test

simulator_evaluator_visible_state: Hidden actual ground truth (y_true at t1)
